stem:
Meera looks at a small flower through three different transparent objects from her science kit, holding each one close to the flower.

Through which one will the flower appear erect and enlarged?

options.text: a flat transparent glass window pane

teacher.key_rationale: A convex lens held close to an object (object within focal length) produces an erect, enlarged virtual image. A concave lens gives an erect but diminished image, a flat glass pane leaves the object looking the same size and shape, and a flat mirror forms a same-size laterally inverted image (and is not viewed 'through'). Key A.
